# Purchased component references

The enclosure and mounting parts are original project geometry. Purchased components remain attributed to their sources.

- **adafruit_6178.step:** Adafruit manufacturer CAD, `6178 1.28in Round TFT` directory in https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_CAD_Parts . Blob SHA `66f39106daee442a08a0b5f994fe7cbfb830bd64`.
- **adafruit_6178.brd:** https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-1.28-240x240-Round-Display-PCB . Mount coordinates were read from this Eagle PCB. PCB attribution and license are retained in `ADAFRUIT_LICENSE.txt`.
- **teensy41_community.step:** carried forward from the user's Grave Bat CAD pack. Original source: https://github.com/AndersonRayner/kicad-libraries/blob/2e8ea5927383ff304f81023fa963b8870af0d132/3D_models/Teensy4.1.STEP . Blob SHA `eb1877c5470dfe27cc60e9312e3b5a175e64a724`.
- **audio_shield_community.step:** carried forward from the same pack. Original repository directory: https://github.com/frsaba/mcguitarpedal/tree/master/pcb/mcguitarpedal/lib/3D_models . Audio model blob SHA `d4833e06b887a93ebacb578bd34cc4932746dc99`.

Community references are not manufacturer-certified models. The actual Audio Adapter revision, headers and solder protrusions need measurement. The packaged references retain their source terms; this pack does not relicense third-party assets.

Buttons, jack, footswitch, headers and trimmer are explicitly marked simplified envelopes in `parts.json`, not downloaded manufacturer CAD.
